title: Unit Event — MORE MORE Making Christmas

meta.Outline: Following the success of the elementary school event, the girls start planning for another show in real life, but encounter various obstacles along the way. Just when things seem difficult, they receive an email from a fan offering to help. Minori is thrilled, but...

rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for tuning in today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope we all get to have fun.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Hi.>
<This is what I've been waiting for!>
<What are you guys gonna do today?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We actually have a guest making a special appearance for us today. Someone I'm sure all of you already know.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Someone we all know?>
<Who could it be?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh. Our guest today is...!
Get ready...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ta-daa! From the “Nanamin Channel”, the one and only Nanamin!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, Airi, that was my line!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You were taking too long!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: So without further ado... Hi, everyone from the MMJ Channel! It's me, Nanamin♪

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Whoa, it's Nanamin!>
<Awesome!!!!>
<Collab #3!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure many of you already know, but we've had Nanamin appear on our channel previously.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, we started talking about how it'd be great to invite her on to our channel the next time we got a chance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you again very much for that time, Nanamin! It's so great to have you here.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Likewise. Thanks for inviting me on!
I'm looking forward to having a nice, long chat with all of you today♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, we will!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's get started! Today's segments are gonna include all of us with an emphasis on Nanamin!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our first segment is... “Nanamin and MMJ Talk About And Sample Their Favorite Snacks♪”

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Shizuku, Airi & Nanamin
rows.Line: Yay!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, that was so good!
I hadn't had a “Mochimame” in such a long time! Great recommendation, Nanamin!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
I'm glad you liked it!
I get these all the time and kind of really want to be in their commercial♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, the one where they all wear those big soybeans on their heads? I saw that commercial all the time as a kid.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, we all brought so many different snacks today. It's been a while since I had this many at once.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me neither. Probably not since elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Haha. I know, right?!
Oh, speaking of elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: You did that event at that one school the other day, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, the graduation event.
You saw it?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was so good!
My friends and I were so stoked about “the return of the masked idol” after we saw it!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<It trended for pic shares too! lol>
<Happy Everyday's so awesome!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Of course!
Airi Momoi and Happy Everyday are both the best idols ever!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So true! Your solo performance even moved me to tears, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it felt the same way!
It was so nice to see you doing Happy Side Steps too...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's what you wanted to see?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I'm still jealous about that.>
<I'd do anything to see MMJ do a show live!!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, look at the comments!
They said that they want to see us do a show!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I'd definitely go see that show!>
<Meet and greets too.>
<I wanna see your show!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... Thank you, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I wanna meet Haruka.>
<I'll go wherever you perform.>
<Yeah, do an event for us!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I don't know what to say.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, it'd be great to do an event where we can meet all of you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. I want to meet all of our fans too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If we're going to do an event, it'd be nice to also do a meet and greet and a mini-concert.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A meet and greet and a mini-concert...?!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Yay! When?>
<I wanna meet you guys as soon as possible!!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We can't say much right now since we'd have to work out a schedule and find a venue...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we promise to start working on it, so please stay tuned, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Great!
I might just go to your meet and greet if you're really going to put on an event♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But you can meet us whenever you want, no?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
And I probably shouldn't take up another fan's spot like that...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I wanna meet you ASAP!>
<Tell us when everything's set!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<But you guys aren't with an agency. Won't it be hard to put on an event?>
<Yeah, how are you gonna find a venue?>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Can't we help them somehow?!>
<I believe in MMJ!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We promise to give you more details once we have everything figured out!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, so let's make it a wonderful event!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Alright, we need to make this an event where we can really spread hope to our fans!!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Great stream today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you again for joining us today, Nanamin. You being here made everything just that much more fun.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you! I had a lot of fun too! We should do this again sometime soon!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Oh, but that might be tough if you're serious about putting on an event, huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, they seemed really excited about us doing one, so we'll need to give it the attention it deserves.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right.
We'll have to find a venue, hire staff and work little by little to make it a reality...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It'd be nice to perform at a large venue, but we'd have to think about how to actually book it and how many people will actually come to see us...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This sounds really hard...!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Hey, I have a suggestion...!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: What if I helped out a little?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Booking a venue and hiring a staff isn't cheap, right?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: I can even ask my agency about places that might be willing to take you on!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That'd be amazing, but are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm sure!
I want to help MMJ as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
That was definitely going to be our biggest hurdle, so we'll take any help we can!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you.
We really appreciate it, Hayakawa.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: You got it! I'll be sure to ask my manager about this during our next meeting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Nanamin!
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Once we've found a venue and hired staff, we'll get to do our own event...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'll get to meet our fans, chat with them and play games with them... Like a real idol during a real show!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no!!
I feel like my head's gonna explode just thinking about it!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Calm down... Don't get ahead of yourself! We don't even have a venue booked yet!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's start by thinking about what we need to do to make this event happen!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But what do we need besides a place to perform and staff to run things...? What shows have I been to...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right! I've been to tons of ASRUN events, meet and greets and fan meetings!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They were all really incredible, and they even had a snow machine for their December events! During April, they'd always sell these cherry blossom glow sticks and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That fan meeting ended up getting canceled...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It was so windy that the rafters were in danger of being blown apart, so they prioritized everyone's safety above all else...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Knowing that accidents like that can happen, putting on an event can't be easy.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We had the teachers and staff there to help us when we performed at that elementary school, but that's not the case this time...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, a big challenge means I have to put in a big effort...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And we have to make this event one that all our fans get to enjoy!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What should we do once we have a place booked? A meet and greet for one, and a mini-concert would be nice...
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, what about this place?
It looks so new and sparkly! And it's right by the station!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It is, but this would put us over the budget too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh?
You two are here pretty early.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, good morning!
Let's make practice a good one!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You seem awfully excited, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
You're just overflowing with enthusiasm.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's because I am! I've been coming up with all sorts of ideas for our event!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's great!
Be sure to tell us about them once we have a venue picked out!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, what were you two just talking about?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We were looking for some candidate venues. We felt bad about having Hayakawa doing everything for us, and it's a good opportunity to learn more about the venues around here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we still haven't found a good place for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see.
We actually tried looking for some staffing agencies that might be able to help us yesterday too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You did?
Did either of you have any luck?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, we have some candidates, but things get pretty expensive around this time of year...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The increase in demand for all the events taking place between Christmas and New Year's in turn also causes prices to increase...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Money, huh...
Even after we talked about what kinds of things we want to do as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but that discussion also came attached with each of being able to “pay our fair share”.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, putting on an event is a completely different story...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Booking a venue and hiring staff alone costs a lot of money...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, what if I take all the money I've made from working and spend it here...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh? “All,” you say?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Well... A little, maybe... Haha...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If it's really starting to sound like we won't have enough, I could put in more and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No! We already discussed that, didn't we? We each pay our fair share.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'm pretty sure that we've also talked about how it's not a good idea to make some work more than others.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay. Right...
Thanks, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: With regards to booking a venue and staffing, we'll just have to wait for Nanamin to get back to us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I understand. Hayakawa did mention that she needed to stop by her agency yesterday to discuss another matter...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, right on cue...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello. This is Kiritani speaking.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
<Hey, Haruka?
Sorry for not getting back to you sooner! Are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, we can talk.
So... How'd everything go?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: <Yeah, about that...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Really? Thank you so much!
You've been a huge help!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. I guess we don't really have a choice. I'll discuss that with the others...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, we really appreciate it. Again, thank you so much. Okay, talk to you later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What'd she say?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She said they found a good venue for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, her agency can apparently book this 500-person hall they use from time to time at a discounted rate.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: On Christmas Day no less...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?! On Christmas Day?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Every venue's usually booked with some kind of event on Christmas...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Based on what Hayakawa just said, her agency originally had it booked for another event, but they ran into some trouble and had to cancel it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This venue was looking for another act to fill that vacancy since they would ultimately be the ones taking the most damage from that happening.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's incredible...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We really get to put on a Christmas event...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa, hold your horses!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, Haruka, you seemed a little concerned towards the end of that conversation.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, well... It sounds like Hayakawa can take care of booking a venue for us that's also within our budget...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But hiring a staff for our event is going to be a challenge.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It is?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Again, there are events of all shapes and sizes being held this time of year, which causes a shortage in supply in terms of event staff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm a little worried about what we should do since Hayakawa's agency won't be able to help us there and how expensive it is to hire through another company...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: These venues usually have their own lighting and sound technicians, but we're gonna need more than that if we're really gonna do a fan meeting...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we'll need receptionists, people to organize lines, check tickets and such.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. Our fans seem to be expecting quite a bit from us, so we're probably going to need extra hands for other activities besides just the meet and greet...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
There's no event without any event staff...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, let's try looking for people who might be able to fill that role!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look for them? How?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Like, um... Asking our friends to help us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's a wonderful idea!
I'll try asking around as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see... That could actually work.
I'll see if anyone in the tea ceremony club can lend us a hand.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Our friends...
I feel a little bad about asking someone to help us like this on Christmas Day...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure some already have plans, but I suppose there's no harm in asking.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'll start by asking Kohane!
After school

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-They all have plans...!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They're all going out with their friends or seeing Christmas events and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You too, huh, Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Me too?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I was told the same thing.
My friends from club all made plans with their friends or family already.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Same. My classmates said they can't come because they're throwing a Christmas party.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Tis the season so I guess it's to be expected...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We might not have any other choice but to increase our budget and hire people from a staffing agency...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll try looking again to see if there's a company that can help us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, hey...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? What is it, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our MORE MORE JUMP! account got an email from someone...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? An email?
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Dear MORE MORE JUMP!
My name is Ayaka Saito. I'm an avid fan of your channel and your streams!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I apologize if this seems rather sudden.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <But I am writing to you today regarding the idea of your group doing a show in real life that came up during your last stream, and I believe that I may be able to help you.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Help us...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I am currently a university student who works part-time as a production staff member.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <My line of work has me interacting with various different idol groups and artists on a regular basis...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <As such, I also have experience working with freelancers who do not belong to any agencies and putting on events for them.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Freelancers of this sort usually do not have a manager or staff around them, which makes it difficult for them to put on any events by themselves.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Real-life events always involve some kind of equipment and personnel to handle them.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <And I am under the impression that your group will inevitably face certain difficulties in terms of putting on an actual event.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <That is where I come in. Would you be willing to allow me to help you gather staff and find a suitable venue as part of helping you put on this event.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <This will purely be volunteer work as well. Quite a few of my friends are also MORE MORE JUMP! fans, so I believe I'll have more than enough hands on board for this.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hold on... This person's serious about helping us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah! It sure sounds like it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At the same time, this sounds too good to be true. What if it's really just someone posing as one of our fans? We need to take this into careful consideration...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. But let's keep reading for now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <And please feel free to disregard this email if you are not having any trouble with your event.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <However, if you are in a position of requiring outside help, I would be more than happy to be of assistance. I solemnly swear to do my absolute best!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry about the long explanation, but I'm really, genuinely looking forward to your event!
Sincerely, Ayaka Saito>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <P.S. My friends and I at the MMJ fan club that I'm running have written up a prospective plan for your event. We hope you take a look at it.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
An MMJ fan club?!
We have a fan club...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm just as surprised. I had no idea. Is that everything, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... No, there's more.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <P.P.S. In my humble opinion, your best stream so far is the one where you all brought different ingredients and had hot pot together.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I didn't expect it to start with veggies and end with roasting marshmallows. I tried roasting some myself after that and really like it. I hope you do another stream like that in the future...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
It certainly sounds like she saw that stream.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, my guess is that she's really a fan of ours.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-This is so incredible...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Who would've guessed that someone like this would show up to save us like this!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mind showing me the attachment this person sent, Airi...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This proposal looks professional...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She and her friends have covered everything from an overall concept, our target audience, a budget and pricing options. They even came up with a few venue layouts...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She said that they work part-time for a production company, but I would've thought that this is her full-time job.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Not only that, she's been paying close attention to us. There's even a part about the best way to showcase ourselves...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This person might just be able to help us give our fans the show they deserve.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And she's willing to write this off as volunteer work without us even asking...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't believe someone's willing to help us like this! Now, our event might just...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is this the right way to go?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want us to spread hope to our fans.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm wondering if we'd be accomplishing that by relying on them for help. Something about that doesn't sit well with me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-Wait, what do you mean?
What's so wrong about that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm talking about how I feel the other side of the stage is “reality”.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Reality...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. The dazzling stage that brings a dreamlike world to life is only made possible by having staff there to actually make it a reality.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And they have to work incredibly hard. They're the ones who move all the heavy equipment, set everything up and move around thousands of people at a time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By agreeing to have this person help us, we'd be making them “work” instead of having fun, no...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In other words, we'd be forcing our fans to face reality and see what goes on behind the scenes...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But she said she works part-time for a production company and has helped put on events before...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That doesn't give us license to say yes to this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want to do everything in my power to make sure our fans get to enjoy our events as fans.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. I get what you're trying to say, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Something about having our fans see the other side of the stage while we try to spread hope from that stage does seem a bit off.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're saying that you want our fans to keep seeing us the way we appear under the spotlight, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, because I'm worried that making them work like this will in turn lead them to not enjoy what we do as fans.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As fans...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But this person...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, this person's offer is almost too good to pass up. Not only do they have experience doing this, she's willing to work pro bono.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I understand that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If it means satisfying the demands of those who want to see us perform live, then we should agree to this offer...

rows.Speaker: Haruka

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Line: <Thank you for visiting today. We deeply regret and apologize for what has happened. With regards to the next meet and greet...>

rows.Line: (Should I talk to Airi about increasing our budget? Or...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:

rows.Line: (That fan of ours, Saito... Their proposal looked so professional and well put together...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And our fans would probably have the most fun if we perform at the venue Hayakawa found for us.)

rows.Line: (But that person's also one of our fans. They must be looking forward to seeing us put on an event just as much as anyone else...)

rows.Line: Maybe I'll find an answer if I go over to see them.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: I enjoy being on stage and working behind the scenes, so I thought, “Why not do both?”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did you see the way Rin and Len turned just now?! Absolute perfection!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank goodness too... Those two have been working so hard on how they turn...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Line: (KAITO's eyes are sparkling like he's watching his own children perform on stage.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I guess it means that he genuinely enjoys supporting those around him and helping them succeed.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'd do anything to have staff like him around for our event. It'd make everything so much easier...)

rows.Line: <And please feel free to disregard this email if you are not having any trouble with your event.>

rows.Line: <However, if you are in a position of requiring outside help, I would be more than happy to be of assistance. I solemnly swear to do my absolute best!>

rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is something on your mind, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? How did you...?

rows.Line: Hehe. Chock it up to being a manager. I can tell at a glance what idols are feeling! Well, a little at least...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:

rows.Line: We've been thinking about putting on our own event but are a bit stuck right now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Having your fans see what goes on behind the scenes... That is a tricky one.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, Haruka, I think I understand why you feel so hesitant.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The stage is a wonderful place that shines, sparkles and makes everyone in the audience smile...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But that light doesn't reach the other side of the stage. It's a place that can be cruel at times.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And you being aware of that fact is why you feel the way you do about exposing your fans to the other side, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I also understand how Minori feels about this. We can't put on an event all on our own, and us not being able to hold one means we'd be disappointing our fans...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we all want to spread and inspire hope in our fans as idols...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If we have some of them see what goes on behind the scenes and they're no longer able to enjoy themselves as fans, I'd...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is just my opinion...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe that idols are able to spread hope to not just the fans in the audience, but those working behind the scenes on the other side as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even all the staff...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! They put their hearts and souls into setting everything up from the lights to the sound from scratch. They want their beloved idols to dazzle as much as possible.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Isn't that a wonderful thing?
I personally feel a great sense of accomplishment whenever I succeed at doing that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You feel that too...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. I have a feeling that these fans of yours suggested this because they want to experience what happens on the other side firsthand.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It'll be a special experience for them since they'll get to see their favorite idols smile by making their event a success.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There's probably no better feeling in the world than when that happens.

rows.Line: They'll get to feel it too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Do our fans really want to help build our event from the ground up and make it a success...? If so, I couldn't be happier...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But even if that's the case...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Is it okay for us to lean on them this much...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I suspect you need more time to find your answer...
song00002_off_sabi

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it's okay to worry and think about it for as long as you like. Ultimately, I think it just comes down to believing in your decision.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I'm sure you'll find a good answer, Haruka. I'm sure things will be just fine.

rows.Speaker: Haruka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Haruka

rows.Line:

rows.Line: When I was still just a fan of you, Haruka, I only ever saw the idol that dazzled everyone... I thought that it must be wonderful to be on stage like that.

rows.Line: You're probably right that I wouldn't have been able to enjoy being a fan and thought that it must be hard being an idol if I saw what's on the other side.

rows.Line: So I do understand your position regarding us having our fans see that.

rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Line: But this is what I really think!

rows.Line: Fans don't just want to see idols shine and sparkle.

rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Line: I mean that fans will be there to support their favorite idols through thick and thin! They'll cheer for them no matter what if it means they'll keep shining!

rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Line: That's when I thought this.

rows.Line: Isn't there anything I can do to help cheer up Haruka and ASRUN...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You were there, Minori...?

rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Line: Unlike you guys, the event at that elementary school was my first and I still probably don't understand yet just how hard everyone on the other side has to work...

rows.Line: Even if they see what's on the other side...No, by seeing the other side, they'll be willing to support us even more! So please...!

rows.Line: So that means...?!

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She truly believes in our fans.)

rows.Line: (They won't be brought down by seeing what's real. They'll be willing to face this if it means we're smiling in the end.)

rows.Line: Of course. You mentioned that you live in Okinawa. I still have that postcard you sent me on display in my living room.

rows.Line: Um... I always loved seeing the perfect Shizuku Hinomori of Cheerful * Days...

rows.Line: We had a discussion about how we can make this moment feel special, and we decided to make something for you in our spare time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku really has a talent for embroidery! The rest of us made you some snacks to go with your present!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We all put a lot of effort into making these, so we really hope that you like them!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Yay! This is so awesome!

rows.Line: There's actually something we'd like to present to you as well, MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Present to us?

rows.Line:
Minori, Haruka, Airi, Shizuku!
Congratulations on a successful first event!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Such a beautiful bouquet...!

rows.Line: Um... I actually applied to work as staff for today because I just wanted a chance to see all of you up close...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Me too. I didn't realize that working on something like this would be so hard, and I was worried that we wouldn't get everything set up in time...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: But seeing all of you putting so much effort into it gave me the motivation to keep going!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Helping MORE MORE JUMP! spread so much hope to others really turned out to be a great experience! Thank you!!

rows.Line: You four are our favorite idols and genuinely lifted our spirits today! I'll never forget what happened today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'll never forget...!
Thank you so much!

rows.Line: It'll be a special experience for them since they'll get to see their favorite idols smile by making their event a success.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But this is what I really think!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Fans don't just want to see idols shine and sparkle.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Fans will be there to support their favorite idols through thick and thin! They'll cheer for them no matter what if it means they'll keep shining!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Thank you, KAITO. Thank you, Minori...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Without you both, I never would've been able to experience this sensation.)

rows.Line: It was wonderful putting this event together with all of you. From the bottom of my heart, thank you...

rows.Line: Thank goodness our event ended up going so well!

rows.Line: I know, right? And I love how they surprised us with this giant bouquet at the end!

rows.Line: I was worried about what would happen at first, but putting on events with our fans like this might be a good way to go for us...

rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: That means we'll have to start expanding our song repertoire.

rows.Line: That'd be great. Why don't we start discussing what we'll be doing the next time we meet?

rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Line: (A lot's happened along the way, but I've gone from being a Haruka admirer to being an idol just like the others...)

rows.Line: (On top of that, we were able to work with our fans to put on an unforgettable event! I couldn't be happier!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I always thought that idols were the only ones who could spread hope to others...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I realize now that our fans can also be just as powerful a source of hope.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Which means I'm gonna need to keep trying harder and harder! I need to spread more and more hope to return the favor!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And I have to keep growing as an idol for that to happen...!)

rows.Line:
Yeah...
Tomorrow, I'm gonna keep trying more and more!!
